obi.get-remote-compiled-object-list: OBI: Get remote compiled object list
obi.get-remote-build-results: OBI: Get last build results from IBM i
obi.source.store-hash: Mark source as built (store current hash)
obi.build.revealOutput: When to show the "OBI Build" output with the live output of builds and build previews.
obi.build.revealOutput.never: Never (open it with "OBI: Show build output")
obi.statusBar.enabled: Show the OBI status bar item (profile, running operation, last build).
obi.log.writeFiles: Write the OBI log into .obi/log of the project (combined.log, error.log). Takes effect after a reload.
obi.log.maxFileSizeMB: Maximum size of a log file in MB; 3 files are kept per log.
obi.buildHistory.maxBuilds: Keep at most this many builds in the build history (0 = unlimited). Older builds are deleted after each build. Until this or `#obi.buildHistory.maxAgeDays#` is set, OBI asks once per workspace before deleting.
obi.buildHistory.maxAgeDays: Delete builds older than this many days from the build history (0 = unlimited).
obi.backend.autoUpdateLocal: Update the local OBI backend (`local-obi-dir`, a git checkout) with `git pull` when VS Code starts. Only fast-forward: a checkout with own commits or changes stays as it is.
obi.backend.autoUpdateRemote: Update the OBI backend on the IBM i (`remote-obi-dir`, a git checkout) with `git pull`, once per VS Code session before the first build. Only fast-forward: a checkout with own commits or changes stays as it is.

obi.timeline.show-compile-messages: Show Compile Messages of this Build
capabilities.untrustedWorkspaces: OBI executes build commands and local programs defined in the project configuration.
capabilities.virtualWorkspaces: OBI needs direct file system access to the project folder.

obi.build.confirmRun: Ask before a build runs ("Build 3 sources on my-ibmi?").

viewsWelcome.no-folder:
OBI builds IBM i objects from sources you keep in a folder on your PC and in git.
[Open Folder](command:vscode.openFolder)
[Open Recent](command:workbench.action.openRecent)
New to OBI? Follow the [walkthrough](command:workbench.action.openWalkthrough?%5B%22andreas-prouza.obi%23obi.getting-started%22%5D) or read [Getting started](https://github.com/andreas-prouza/obi-extension/blob/main/asserts/docs/getting-started.md).
viewsWelcome.no-project:
This folder has no OBI project yet.
[Initialize OBI Project](command:obi.initialize-folder)
Initialize adds the .obi folder with a default configuration and a sample source. Existing files are kept.
New to OBI? Follow the [walkthrough](command:workbench.action.openWalkthrough?%5B%22andreas-prouza.obi%23obi.getting-started%22%5D) or read [Getting started](https://github.com/andreas-prouza/obi-extension/blob/main/asserts/docs/getting-started.md).
Added the project another way, e.g. with git? [Reload the window](command:workbench.action.reloadWindow).
viewsWelcome.config-invalid:
OBI can't use the configuration of this project: a configuration file can't be read, or a path in it isn't allowed, e.g. the root folder, or the home folder of the SSH user as project folder in the IFS. The error message says which.
[Open Configuration](command:obi.controller.config)
OBI checks again when a configuration file is saved. If that doesn't happen, [reload the window](command:workbench.action.reloadWindow).

viewsWelcome.build-packages:
A build package is a named list of sources that are always built together with their dependent objects, e.g. for a ticket. Packages are stored in .obi/build-packages and shared with your team via git.
[Create Build Package](command:obi.build-package.create)

obi.buildPackages.baseBranch: Branch that *Add sources changed on this branch to build package* compares the current branch with, e.g. `main` or `origin/develop`. Empty: the default branch of `origin`, otherwise `main` or `master`.
